evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Enlarged with mucoid degeneration
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Complex tear of the posterior horn with extrusion and a displaced fragment into the intercondylar region.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
evidence.Medial OA: Area of high-grade chondrosis in the weightbearing portion of the femoral condyle.
evidence.Lateral OA: Small, marginal osteophytes in the medial and lateral compartments.
evidence.PF OA: Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Low-grade chondrosis in the trochlea.
evidence.Contusion: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
evidence.Fracture: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
